description: Check what Korean customs clearance requirements apply to a product by its 10-digit HS code. Goods that need an unmet approval are held or returned at Korean customs. Returns which statutes require clearance, which agencies can approve (often several, any one of which suffices), the certificate to obtain, and each requirement's condition quoted from the governing notice (Korean original, which is authoritative) — plus tariff rates for imports. Data: Korea Customs Service and the Ministry of Government Legislation. Fact lookup only — not a legal customs determination; whether a condition applies to your product is not decided here. Test code 8516710000 (coffee makers) is free.

hs_code.description: 10-digit Korean HS (HSK) code, dots/hyphens allowed. 6 digits returns the 10-digit candidates.

name: check_korea_import_requirements
title: Check Korean import/export clearance requirements by HS code
